entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The flying ship of Gerrard's crew, wrecked in Mercadia and later seized and repaired.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: The captain of the Weatherlight, who loses his ship in Mercadia and is manipulated by Takara.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Gerrard's brother Vuel, corrupted into a servant of the Lord of Phyrexia, who disguises himself as Takara.

entities.name: Takara
entities.description: A woman who joins Gerrard's crew and encourages his hate; she is revealed to be Volrath in disguise.

entities.name: Starke
entities.description: Takara's blind and paranoid father, said to be a conniving stranger who corrupted Vuel; he is killed by Takara.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: A healer of the Weatherlight crew who lives with the Cho-Arrim and develops the gift of chavala.

entities.name: Cho-Manno
entities.description: The leader of the Cho-Arrim, who falls in love with Orim and helps lead the rebellion.

entities.name: Is-Shada
entities.description: A Cho-Arrim woman who befriends Orim and believes she has the gift of healing.

entities.name: Klaars
entities.description: A wounded crew member who turns violent against the Cho-Arrim and is executed.

entities.name: Ta-Spon
entities.description: The Cho-Arrim executioner.

entities.name: Ta-Karnst
entities.description: A Cho-Arrim healer who works with Orim.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member who repairs the ship.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A pacifist silver golem of the Weatherlight crew who connects to the ship's engine.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin cabin boy treated as a hero by the Mercadian Kyren.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A minotaur first mate of the Weatherlight, scarred by his time on Rath.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member who is wounded and healed by Orim.

entities.name: Atalla
entities.description: A young Mercadian farmer who helps the crew and later becomes a leader of Mercadia.

entities.name: Xcric
entities.description: The commander of the cateran mercenaries, hired to arrest Gerrard.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A dead crew member honored at the memorial service.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A crew member who did not make the planeshift jump.

entities.name: Oustrathmer
entities.description: A Saprazzan conspirator who commands Orim's guard.

entities.name: Lahaime
entities.description: The leader of the Ramosans.

entities.name: Ramos
entities.description: A Phyrexian turned by Urza into a protector, revealed as a dragon engine worshipped as a god, whose body broke into the Bones of Ramos.

entities.name: Orhop
entities.description: Ramos's evil brother in the Cho-Arrim myth.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The artificer who saved Ramos and turned him into a protector of humans.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: A Phyrexian-aligned captain Tahngarth fears he might have joined.

entities.name: Lord of Phyrexia
entities.description: The master Volrath serves.

entities.name: Cho-Arrim
entities.description: The forest people of the Rushwood led by Cho-Manno, who see the Weatherlight as the sign of Ramos's return.

entities.name: Kyren
entities.description: The goblin advisers of the Mercadian magistrate.

entities.name: Cateran
entities.description: Mercadian mercenaries and enforcers.

entities.name: Ramosans
entities.description: The followers of Ramos who rebel against the Kyren.

entities.name: Saprazzans
entities.description: The sea people of Saprazzo.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: A plane of commerce where everything is for sale.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: The city built upon an upside-down mountain, seat of the magistrate.

entities.name: Magistrate's Tower
entities.description: The tower in Mercadia City where the magistrate holds court.

entities.name: Rushwood
entities.description: The living forest home of the Cho-Arrim.

entities.name: Ouramos
entities.description: The crater temple holding the Bones of Ramos.

entities.name: Saprazzo
entities.description: A city built within a submerged caldera, home of the Saprazzans.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane the Weatherlight escaped.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The home plane the crew planeshifts back to.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The source of the Phyrexian ships in Mercadia.

entities.name: Bones of Ramos
entities.description: Five crystalline powerstones from Ramos's body: the Eye, Skull, Heart, Horn and Tooth.

entities.name: Power Matrix
entities.description: The artifact that repairs the Weatherlight, said to be Ramos's heart.

entities.name: Juju Bubble
entities.description: An item Karn carried that links the Bones of Ramos together.

entities.name: Recreant
entities.description: Volrath's Phyrexian ship, destroyed by the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Uniter
entities.description: A great metal serpent foretold to reunite the peoples of Ramos.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The ancient war whose connection to Mercadia the crew seeks.

entities.name: Revolution on Mercadia
entities.description: The uprising of the people against Mercadian tyranny.

events.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands on Atalla's family farm in Mercadia.
events.quote: A young man named Atalla watches as the Weatherlight crash lands on one of the fields of his family’s farm.

events.summary: A sudden flood carries off the Weatherlight with warriors on boats during Mirri's memorial.
events.quote: A memorial service for Mirri and the other dead is interrupted by a sudden flood that brings in a band of warriors on boats and that starts to carry off the Weatherlight.

events.summary: Klaars attacks Is-Shada and kills the guard while escaping the Cho-Arrim cell.
events.quote: When Is-Shada brings them a meal, Klaars pounces on her, rendering her unconscious, and then attacks and kills the guard.

events.summary: Klaars is executed by Ta-Spon.
events.quote: At the leader’s nod, Klaars is dispatched.

events.summary: Gerrard negotiates a truce with the Mercadian riders and surrenders his weapons.
events.quote: Gerrard negotiates a truce and they agree to give up their weapons in exchange for the treatment of the wounded and proper burial of the dead.

events.summary: Atalla steals the guard captain's keys, freeing Gerrard's crew.
events.quote: Atalla steals his keys and unlocks Gerrard’s shackles.

events.summary: A cateran enforcer submits to Squee, allowing the crew to escape.
events.quote: At the sight of Squee, the cateran enforcer stops and seeks pardon from the goblin.

events.summary: Gerrard strikes a deal with the magistrate to train the Mercadian army and march on the Cho-Arrim to retrieve his ship.
events.quote: Gerrard proposes that he train the Mercadian army and then march them against their common enemy, the Cho-Arrim, to retrieve his ship.

events.summary: The Cho-Arrim treat the Weatherlight as the sign of the return of Ramos.
events.quote: The Weatherlight is treated as the sign of the return of Ramos, their god.

events.summary: The Cho-Arrim repel a cateran attack on the Rushwood, which had come to seize the Weatherlight.
events.quote: The tide turns and the Cho-Arrim skyscouts fly down to surround the caterans.

events.summary: Tahngarth confesses that he wishes he had died on Rath rather than live with the changes Volrath made.
events.quote: He wishes he had died there instead of having to live with the twisted changes effected upon him by Volrath.

events.summary: Orim and Cho-Manno kiss.
events.quote: Cho Manno agrees and they kiss.

events.summary: Xcric defies Gerrard's order and shoots at watching eyes in the forest.
events.quote: so he shoots at a pair of eyes in the forest that is watching them.

events.summary: The caterans massacre the Cho-Arrim settlement.
events.quote: As the cateran mercenaries emerge out of the forest into the Cho-Arrim settlement they start massacring everyone.

events.summary: Xcric arrests Gerrard, whom the magistrate had hired him to set up.
events.quote: Xcric approaches him and suddenly binds his wrists in shackles.

events.summary: Orim rejects Gerrard's apology at his staged trial.
events.quote: Orim simply threw her turban at his feet.

events.summary: Squee and Atalla drug the guards' wine to free the crew.
events.quote: The wine proves to be drugged, and Atalla secures the key to their shackles.

events.summary: Garbage falls on Xcric instead of the condemned Gerrard, Karn and Tahngarth.
events.quote: what they see is tons of filth fall right on top of Xcric!

events.summary: The magistrate lets the crew keep the Weatherlight in exchange for a mission to Saprazzo for the Matrix.
events.quote: The magistrate agrees to allow them to repair and keep the Weatherlight, in exchange for using it on a mission of the magistrate's choice.

events.summary: A Saprazzan warrior beast drags Orim under the sea.
events.quote: the warrior beast grabs Orim and drags her under the sea.

events.summary: In a flashback, Gerrard recounts rescuing his brother Vuel at his coming-of-age ceremony, which led to Vuel becoming Volrath.
events.quote: which started with Gerrard rescuing his brother Vuel from death during his coming-of-age ceremony

events.summary: Karn reveals that Starke corrupted Vuel and warns Gerrard not to trust Takara.
events.quote: Vuel only became Volrath when a vicious, conniving stranger came to their village and corrupted him

events.summary: Orim arrives riding the whale-like creature and heals the dying Sisay.
events.quote: She calls on both sides to put away their arms, and then she heals Sisay.

events.summary: The grand vizier recounts the myth of Ramos as a flashback.
events.quote: Ramos was a powerful artificer who ruled over an entire world until he became obsessed with reaching the stars themselves.

events.summary: Orim is framed for murder and theft by the Saprazzan conspirator Oustrathmer.
events.quote: She awakes to find the Saprazzan conspirator as the commander of her guard, a man named Oustrathmer.

events.summary: Takara kills her father Starke before the Kyren, then reveals herself as Volrath.
events.quote: As the blood drains from Starke’s body, Takara metamorphoses into Volrath.

events.summary: Cho-Manno, believed dead, appears and clears Orim's name through a mind meld.
events.quote: Orim submits to a mind meld with Cho-Manno, who then declares her innocence.

events.summary: Volrath kills the chief artificer for failing to join the Power Matrix to the Weatherlight.
events.quote: For her failure, Volrath kills her too, but at least now her assistant, the new chief, knows what they need.

events.summary: Disguised as guards, the crew and Cho-Manno free Gerrard using a storm.
events.quote: The new guards are the rest of the Weatherlight crew, plus Cho-Manno.

events.summary: The party is attacked by Deepwood ghouls on the way to Ouramos.
events.quote: they are attacked by Deepwood ghouls.

events.summary: Squee discovers the secret underground hangar and stumbles into a Phyrexian.
events.quote: he stumbles into a Phyrexian!

events.summary: Gerrard learns in a trance that Ramos was a Phyrexian saved by Urza.
events.quote: Ramos was originally a Phyrexian created to hunt humans, but Urza saved him and turned him into a creature designed to save humans

events.summary: The dryads, forest and Ramos unite their minds, making the powerstones shine.
events.quote: Only when the dryads and the forest all unite their minds with Ramos do the powerstones emit light as bright as the sun.

events.summary: Takara makes off with the powerstones.
events.quote: Unfortunately, during the night, Takara makes off with the powerstones.

events.summary: Takara, morphing into Volrath, takes Hanna and Karn captive and forces Hanna to repair the Weatherlight.
events.quote: soon she morphs into her form as Volrath, who takes them captive.

events.summary: The Weatherlight engine starts just as Volrath shoots at Squee.
events.quote: Just as Volrath shoots a crossbow bolt at Squee, the engine starts and the bolt just misses.

events.summary: The Ramosans rebel against the Kyren and kill the Chief Magistrate and his advisors.
events.quote: They make their way towards the Magistrate’s Tower and attack and kill the Chief Magistrate and his Kyren advisors.

events.summary: Gerrard defeats Volrath in a sword fight by attacking his weak side.
events.quote: Gerrard takes his chance and attacks the right, breaking through Volrath’s defenses, felling him.

events.summary: Gerrard and Sisay are pulled aboard the Weatherlight, which Karn now controls through its engine.
events.quote: Now a rope comes down and Hanna and Tahngarth pull the two up on board.

events.summary: The Weatherlight rams and destroys the Recreant; Volrath retreats to Rath.
events.quote: The stern rams into the Recreant, and destroys all but its prow

events.summary: Ramos appears as a dragon engine and is hailed as the Uniter.
events.quote: Ramos and Orhop have fought and been united in the form of a dragon.

events.summary: Orim, Cho-Manno and Atalla become the new leaders of Mercadia as the crew planeshifts back to Dominaria.
events.quote: They return with Orim, Cho-Manno, and Atalla, new leaders of Mercadia.
